summary: Iteration-2 review: covered payments (simulated), 80G receipt PDF, /api/media serving, admin uploads, phone OTP login, admin donations tab + KPIs, logo, favicon, and dashboard receipts archive. Backend: 27/29 new pytest tests pass; the 2 red tests correctly surface REAL BUGS in _create_payment cap and OTP rate limiting. Iteration-1 regression: 44/44 still pass. Frontend: donation modal → simulated confirm → receipt PBTC/80G/2026-27/xxxx with download button works; phone OTP login end-to-end works (dev code 123456 rendered in auth-dev-code, header switches to Dashboard, Dashboard shows auth method 'phone' and empty receipts state); admin blog cover upload uploads a real PNG to /api/media/... and preview renders; logo present in header, footer, ID card, admin header; favicon+title correct. Two BLOCKING frontend runtime errors on /admin were fixed here by adding missing imports (useRef, Download, ImageUp) and by adding the missing 'Donations' entry to the admin TABS array so the /admin/donations tab is actually reachable.

critical.issue: Life membership fee is ₹11,000 (1100000 paise) but _create_payment uses the donation cap MAX_DONATION=1000000, so /membership/checkout for tier 'life' returns 400 'Amount must be between ₹20 and ₹10000'. Users cannot pay for Life membership. Fix: skip MIN/MAX_DONATION range check when kind=='membership', or raise the ceiling for membership.

Rate limiting is not effective. Code path in server.py:355-372: count_documents(recent) is checked, then delete_many({'phone': phone, 'consumed': False}) is called BEFORE insert. Since prior non-consumed records are wiped every request, the count only ever sees 0 or 1 and the >=3 guard never triggers. Verified: 4 consecutive requests for the same phone all return 200 instead of 429 on the 4th. Fix: either count with different criteria (e.g. count issued OTPs in window regardless of consumed) or move the deletion after the rate-limit check and delete only expired records.

minor.issue: OtpRequestIn returns Pydantic 422 for a too-short phone rather than the intended HTTP 400 raised in the function body. Cosmetic — tests loosened to accept (400, 422).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED HERE. Runtime ReferenceError 'useRef is not defined' crashed the Admin blog + event modals as soon as they opened. `useRef` was used but not imported from 'react'.
FIXED HERE. Runtime ReferenceError 'Download is not defined' when navigating to the Donations tab — <Download/> lucide icon was used in the receipt link but not imported.
FIXED HERE. Runtime ReferenceError 'ImageUp is not defined' — the ImageUp lucide icon was used in the Upload image button but not imported.

FIXED HERE. 'Donations' was missing from the TABS array, so the admin-tab-donations button never rendered and the whole Donations panel (with simulated warning + receipts) was unreachable from the UI even though the tab-content block existed.

action_items: BACKEND: In backend/server.py:_create_payment (line 650), do not apply MIN_DONATION/MAX_DONATION cap to kind=='membership' — Life tier (₹11,000) is currently blocked. Alternatively raise MAX_DONATION to at least 1100000 paise, or gate the check on kind.

BACKEND: In backend/server.py request_otp (line 349), fix rate limiting. Either count all OTPs (consumed or not) issued in the last 10 min, or only delete expired records before insert. Currently 4th+ request from the same number is not blocked.
OPTIONAL: In backend/server.py request_otp, use HTTPException(400) explicitly at the model boundary or add a validator on OtpRequestIn.phone so short numbers give a nice 400 instead of Pydantic 422.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:650 amount cap MIN/MAX_DONATION unconditionally applied to membership fees — root cause of Life tier bug.
server.py:361 request_otp deletes non-consumed prior records BEFORE the count-based rate check has any teeth — rate limit is effectively bypassed.

server.py:717 campaign 'raised' is incremented in rupees (amount/100), but campaign.raised is a number (not paise). Test verified progress bar reflects change; but mixed units of paise (payment.amount) vs rupees (campaign.raised) is fragile and could be documented.
server.py:717 uses $inc with a float (amount/100) — for odd paise values this can leak floating point drift into a currency field. Consider dividing/rounding explicitly or storing raised in paise.
server.py:874 /api/media is a public GET but streams full bytes into memory via StarResponse — fine for image uploads (10MB cap) but consider StreamingResponse if larger media is added later.
server.py:864 receipt PDF ownership check is correct (owner OR admin); test confirmed 200 for owner, 200 for admin, 403 for third-party phone user, 401 unauth, 404 for missing id.

rca of the issue: Life-tier checkout: _create_payment applies the donation cap regardless of kind — the exact same helper is reused for donations AND memberships, but the caps are donation-specific (MIN_DONATION=₹20, MAX_DONATION=₹10,000). Life membership is priced at ₹11,000, so it always fails validation. Mitigation: gate `if amount < MIN_DONATION or amount > MAX_DONATION` on `if kind == 'donation'` (or use per-kind caps). OTP rate limit: the intent was 'no more than 3 requests / 10 min per phone', but request_otp.delete_many({consumed:false}) runs after the count and wipes the records that the count would need to see next time. Effectively only the most recent record ever survives, so the count is always 0 or 1. Mitigation: (a) do not delete non-consumed OTPs before insert — just let the newest one supersede via the sort in verify_otp; or (b) delete only expired/consumed records; or (c) count includes recently-consumed records too.
